A11yPreserve Heading Fixture
Research Overview
This fixture introduces the research problem and establishes a deliberate heading hierarchy.
Background
Accessible structure can be preserved only when conversion retains the source document's 
intended semantics.
Prior Work
Prior accessibility research shows that document transformation can change structure and 
metadata.
Methods
The pilot compares source semantics with tagged PDF semantics using deterministic extraction.
